title: Wave of False Bomb Threats Causes Chaos for European Flights
subtitle: Authorities investigate a series of fake security alerts that have disrupted air travel across the continent this week.

summary.en: A series of fake bomb threats has forced dozens of flights across Europe to change their plans or land early. These incidents have affected many major airlines and airports throughout the week. While all planes landed safely and no real danger was found, officials are concerned about the coordinated nature of the alerts. Some threats were linked to an extremist group, though investigators have not confirmed this connection yet. Experts are now working to identify who is behind these disruptive actions.
summary.zh: 一系列假炸彈威脅迫使歐洲數十個航班更改計畫或提前降落。這些事件在本週影響了許多大型航空公司與機場。雖然所有飛機皆安全降落且未發現實際危險，但官員對這些警告的協調性感到擔憂。部分威脅與一個極端組織有關，儘管調查人員尚未證實此關聯。專家目前正致力於查明這些破壞行動的幕後主使。

paragraphs.en: A series of fake bomb threats has caused significant trouble for air travel across Europe this week. At least 34 flights have been forced to change their routes or make emergency landings as part of what appears to be a coordinated effort to cause confusion and fear. These incidents follow a similar wave of warnings earlier in the week, bringing the total number of affected flights to over 30.
paragraphs.zh: 本週歐洲航空業因一系列假炸彈威脅而陷入嚴重混亂。至少有三十四個航班被迫更改航線或進行緊急降落，這似乎是有組織的行動，旨在製造混亂與恐懼。這些事件發生在週初類似的警告浪潮之後，受影響的航班總數已超過三十架次。

paragraphs.en: The disruptions have touched many countries, including Italy, Ireland, the UK, Spain, and several others. Airlines such as Ryanair, Aer Lingus, and easyJet have all reported issues. According to The Guardian, while these events caused stress for passengers and crew, every plane landed safely. After thorough searches by police and security teams, no dangerous items were found on any of the aircraft.
paragraphs.zh: 這些干擾波及許多國家，包括義大利、愛爾蘭、英國、西班牙等。瑞安航空 (Ryanair)、愛爾蘭航空 (Aer Lingus) 和易捷航空 (easyJet) 等航空公司皆回報了相關問題。根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，儘管這些事件造成乘客與機組人員的壓力，但所有飛機皆安全降落。經由警方與安全小組徹底搜查後，並未在任何飛機上發現危險物品。

paragraphs.en: In the United Kingdom, London’s Heathrow Airport and Birmingham Airport received threats overnight. Specialist police officers from the Metropolitan police’s aviation command helped determine that these warnings were hoaxes—false reports intended to trick people. The police noted that after checking four specific aircraft, they found no security issues. Similar incidents occurred elsewhere, such as at Cork Airport, where an anonymous phone call caused a flight delay.
paragraphs.zh: 在英國，倫敦希斯洛機場 (Heathrow Airport) 與伯明罕機場 (Birmingham Airport) 於夜間接獲威脅。倫敦都會區警察局的航空指揮部專業警官協助判定這些警告為惡作劇，即意圖欺騙大眾的虛假通報。警方指出，在檢查四架特定飛機後，未發現任何安全問題。類似事件也發生在其他地方，例如科克機場 (Cork Airport)，一通匿名電話導致航班延誤。

paragraphs.en: Investigators are working hard to find the source of these messages. Some threats sent to airports in Rome and Sofia were signed by a group calling itself “fighters of the Male State.” This is a far-right movement known for its extreme views. However, as reported by The Guardian, the group’s founder did not claim responsibility for the threats on his public social media channels. At this time, officials say there is no clear evidence that a specific country or a major terrorist organization is behind the attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 調查人員正全力追查這些訊息的來源。部分寄往羅馬與索菲亞機場的威脅信件，署名為一個自稱「男性國家戰士」(fighters of the Male State) 的組織。這是一個以極端觀點聞名的極右翼運動。然而，據《衛報》報導，該組織創辦人並未在其公開社群媒體頻道上承認對這些威脅負責。目前官員表示，尚無明確證據顯示有特定國家或大型恐怖組織在幕後策劃這些攻擊。

paragraphs.en: European officials are taking the situation very seriously. Apostolos Tzitzikostas, the European Union transport commissioner, stated that while it is too early to know if all the incidents are connected, any threat against civilians is unacceptable. The International Air Transport Association (IATA), which represents airlines globally, also condemned the actions. Nick Careen, a senior leader at IATA, emphasized that safety is the industry’s number one priority and that all warnings are treated as real until proven otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲官員正嚴肅看待此情況。歐盟交通執委阿波斯托洛斯·齊齊科斯塔斯 (Apostolos Tzitzikostas) 表示，雖然現在斷定所有事件是否相關尚言之過早，但任何針對平民的威脅都是不可接受的。代表全球航空公司的國際航空運輸協會 (IATA) 也譴責了這些行為。國際航空運輸協會的高階主管尼克·卡林 (Nick Careen) 強調，安全是該產業的首要任務，所有警告在證實為假之前，皆會被視為真實威脅處理。

paragraphs.en: These events are part of a wider pattern of concern regarding “hybrid warfare.” This term refers to a mix of military and non-military actions, such as cyberattacks or spreading false information, used to destabilize a region without starting a traditional war. Earlier this week, reports emerged of cyberattacks hitting supermarket refrigeration systems and medical storage facilities across Europe, raising further questions about the security of essential services.
paragraphs.zh: 這些事件是關於「混合戰」(hybrid warfare) 更廣泛擔憂的一部分。此術語是指結合軍事與非軍事手段，例如網路攻擊或散布假訊息，旨在不發動傳統戰爭的情況下破壞區域穩定。本週稍早，有報導指出歐洲各地的超市冷藏系統與醫療儲存設施遭到網路攻擊，這進一步引發了對基礎服務安全性的質疑。

paragraphs.en: Despite the high number of disruptions, the affected flights represent only a very small part of the total air traffic in Europe. According to the European air traffic control agency, Eurocontrol, there were over 27,000 flights scheduled on Thursday alone. Most travelers were able to reach their destinations without major issues, though the incidents have caused significant concern among airline staff and airport authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管干擾事件頻傳，但受影響的航班僅佔歐洲總空中交通量的一小部分。根據歐洲空中航行安全組織 (Eurocontrol) 的數據，僅在週四當天就有超過兩萬七千個航班預定起飛。大多數旅客皆能順利抵達目的地，未發生重大問題，儘管這些事件已在航空公司員工與機場當局之間引起了極大關注。

paragraphs.en: As investigations continue across multiple countries, the focus remains on identifying the people responsible for these hoaxes. Authorities are analyzing the emails and phone calls to see if they share a common origin. For now, passengers are advised to follow the instructions of airline staff and local police. While the threats have been proven false, the industry remains on high alert to ensure that the skies stay safe for everyone. The situation serves as a reminder of how easily modern travel systems can be targeted by those looking to create chaos through digital or psychological means.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著多國調查持續進行，重點仍放在查明這些惡作劇的幕後黑手。當局正分析電子郵件與電話，以確認它們是否源自同一處。目前建議乘客遵循航空公司人員與當地警方的指示。雖然威脅已被證實為假，但航空業仍保持高度警戒，以確保天空對所有人保持安全。此情況提醒了大眾，現代旅遊系統是多麼容易成為那些試圖透過數位或心理手段製造混亂者的目標。

keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「觸摸」，這裡指事件影響了多個國家。文中：The disruptions have touched many countries, including Italy, Ireland, the UK, Spain, and several others.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Responsible for or the cause of something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 在背後主導、是...的幕後黑手。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「在...後面」，這裡指事件的幕後策劃者。文中：At this time, officials say there is no clear evidence that a specific country or a major terrorist organization is behind the attacks.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Prepared to deal with an emergency or danger.
keyTerms.noteZh: 形容處於隨時準備應對危險的狀態。文中：While the threats have been proven false, the industry remains on high alert to ensure that the skies stay safe for everyone.

These incidents follow similar warnings earlier in the week, bringing the total number of affected flights to over 30. While all planes landed safely and no explosives were found, the events have caused significant concern among authorities. Investigators are currently working to identify the source of these threats. This situation follows a recent series of cyberattacks that targeted food and medical cooling systems in several European countries.

previousArticles.summaryEn: A series of cyberattacks has hit supermarket refrigeration systems across at least 10 European countries. The attacks involve hackers remotely raising freezer temperatures, leading to significant food waste. UK meat suppliers have also reported being caught in the crossfire of these digital incidents. Security experts warn that many businesses are using old technology that is easy to hack. Officials are now urging companies to update their systems to prevent future disruptions to the food supply.

previousArticles.title: Cyberattacks on European Cooling Systems Target Vital Medical Supplies
previousArticles.summaryEn: A series of cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems has expanded from supermarkets to include medical facilities in France. Hackers successfully accessed control systems at blood storage sites, forcing temperatures to dangerous levels. While technicians prevented the loss of medical products, the incident marks a worrying escalation in the ongoing digital campaign across Europe. Officials are now working together to understand the source of these attacks and improve security. Experts suggest these actions could be a demonstration of power by state-sponsored actors.

quiz.question: What did the investigation into the threats at London's Heathrow and Birmingham airports reveal?

options.A: The threats were linked to a specific terrorist organization.
options.B: The warnings were confirmed to be false reports after police inspections.
options.C: A suspicious item was discovered on one of the four aircraft searched.
options.D: The threats were traced back to the 'fighters of the Male State' movement.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，倫敦希斯洛機場與伯明罕機場接獲威脅後，警方經調查確認這些警告為「hoaxes」（惡作劇/假消息），且檢查四架飛機後並未發現安全問題。選項 A 與 D 錯誤，因為文章第四段明確指出目前沒有證據顯示特定國家或大型恐怖組織涉案，且該組織創辦人並未承認。選項 C 錯誤，因為文中明確提到檢查後並未發現任何危險物品。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of these fake bomb threats on European air travel?

options.A: The majority of flights in Europe were cancelled due to the high volume of threats.
options.B: The aviation industry is currently unable to distinguish between real and fake threats.
options.C: The primary goal of the perpetrators is to create widespread anxiety rather than physical destruction.
options.D: These incidents have permanently changed the way European air traffic control operates.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第一段提到這些威脅是為了「cause confusion and fear」（製造混亂與恐懼），且第八段提到這是透過「digital or psychological means」（數位或心理手段）製造混亂，可推論其目的在於心理影響而非實體破壞。選項 A 錯誤，因為第七段提到受影響航班僅佔總數極小部分。選項 B 錯誤，因為第五段提到業界會將所有威脅視為真實直到證實為止，這是標準程序而非無法分辨。選項 D 在文中並無依據。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the term 'hybrid warfare' imply in the context of the article?

options.A: A combination of military force and non-military tactics to cause instability.
options.B: A new type of war involving only cyberattacks on medical facilities.
options.C: The use of traditional military weapons to protect essential services.
options.D: A coordinated effort by countries to improve regional security.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文章第六段明確定義「hybrid warfare」為「a mix of military and non-military actions... used to destabilize a region」（混合軍事與非軍事行動，用以破壞區域穩定）。選項 B 錯誤，因為文中僅將網路攻擊作為例子，而非定義其僅限於此。選項 C 與文章含義完全相反，因為這是為了破壞而非保護。選項 D 錯誤，因為這是為了破壞穩定，而非改善安全。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main message of the article?

options.A: A detailed report on the history of the 'fighters of the Male State' movement.
options.B: An analysis of how European airports can prevent all future cyberattacks.
options.C: A description of the safety protocols used by Ryanair and easyJet during emergencies.
options.D: An overview of recent fake bomb threats as a form of destabilizing psychological warfare.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文主要報導近日歐洲發生的假炸彈威脅事件，並將其連結至「混合戰爭」（hybrid warfare）的概念，探討其作為製造混亂與心理恐懼的手段。選項 A 僅是文章的一小部分細節。選項 B 在文中並未提供具體的預防分析。選項 C 提到的航空公司僅是受影響的例子，並非文章的核心主題。因此 D 選項最能涵蓋全文的主旨。
